scripts.build: node -e "const cmd = process.env.npm_config_user_agent && process.env.npm_config_user_agent.includes('pnpm') ? 'pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build' : 'npm run build --workspaces --if-present'; require('child_process').execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.typecheck: node -e "const cmd = process.env.npm_config_user_agent && process.env.npm_config_user_agent.includes('pnpm') ? 'pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter \"./artifacts/**\" --filter \"./scripts\" --if-present run typecheck' : 'npx tsc --build --if-present'; require('child_process').execSync(cmd, { stdio: 'inherit' })"
